Title: Admin logs in with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Enter username | 3. Enter password | 4. Click Login
Expected Result: User lands on the Dashboard (URL ends /dashboard/index) and the main menu is shown
Expected Result Source: HR logic: valid credentials must succeed. URL and menu seen in an automated exploration run

Title: Valid username with wrong password
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Enter valid username | 3. Enter a wrong password | 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Red alert shows 'Invalid credentials'; user stays on the login page

Title: Unknown username with any password
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Enter a username that does not exist | 3. Enter any password | 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Same 'Invalid credentials' alert; user stays on the login page
Expected Result Source: Assumption: the message should not reveal whether the username exists. To confirm manually

Title: Wrong username with the correct password
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Enter a wrong username | 3. Enter the valid password | 4. Click Login
Expected Result: 'Invalid credentials' alert; user stays on the login page

Title: Submit with both fields empty
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Leave both fields empty | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: 'Required' appears under both Username and Password; no login attempt

Title: Submit with username only
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Enter a username | 3. Leave password empty | 4. Click Login

Title: Submit with password only
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Leave username empty | 3. Enter a password | 4. Click Login
Expected Result Source: Assumption (mirror of TC-LOGIN-006). Seen in automated run

Title: Password field hides what is typed
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Type in the Password field
Expected Result Source: HR logic: passwords must not be shown. Field type is 'password' (seen in automated run)

Title: Password is case-sensitive
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Enter valid username | 3. Enter the valid password in a different letter case | 4. Click Login
Test Data: Valid username; valid password in UPPERCASE
Expected Result: 'Invalid credentials'; user stays on the login page
Expected Result Source: HR logic: passwords are case-sensitive. Rejection seen in automated run

Title: Username letter case

Test Data: Valid username in UPPERCASE; valid password
Expected Result: OBSERVATION only: automated run logged in successfully. Record what you see; not a pass/fail

Title: Very long username
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Paste a 300-character username | 3. Enter any password | 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected cleanly ('Invalid credentials' or a length message); no error page or crash
Expected Result Source: Assumption. Invalid credentials alert seen in automated run

Title: Logout returns to the login page
Preconditions: User is logged in as admin
Steps: 1. Click the user name at top right | 2. Click Logout
Expected Result: User is taken to the login page

Title: Back button after logout does not show the app
Steps: 1. Click the browser Back button | 2. Wait for the page to settle
Expected Result: User ends on the login page; dashboard data is not usable
Expected Result Source: HR logic: a logged-out session must not reach HR data. Login page seen in automated run
Manual Notes: Re-run after the case was explained; tester confirmed Pass

Title: Protected URL while logged out redirects to login
Steps: 1. Open the PIM employee list URL directly
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page
Expected Result Source: HR logic. Redirect seen in automated run

Title: Page refresh keeps the session
Expected Result: User stays on the Dashboard and is not asked to log in again
Expected Result Source: Assumption: a normal refresh should not end the session. Seen in automated run

Title: Forgot your password link opens Reset Password
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Click 'Forgot your password?'
Expected Result: The Reset Password page opens (URL ends /auth/requestPasswordResetCode)
Expected Result Source: On-screen behavior (seen in automated run). Actual reset is out of scope (needs email)

Title: Disabled user cannot log in
Preconditions: A non-admin user exists and an admin has set its status to Disabled (needs the Admin module)
Steps: 1. Open the login page | 2. Enter the disabled user's credentials | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected and the dashboard is not shown. Red alert shows 'Account disabled'
Expected Result Source: HR logic: disabled accounts must lose access. Message is on-screen text confirmed in the manual run. Automate after Admin user management is covered
Actual Result: Login rejected; message 'Account disabled' shown as a red warning
